findings.detail: Hydration captures child (unique_id,item_index) identities and rejects duplicates. Two same-template fresh children both UID0 cause AmbiguousSocketIdentity before global issuance. Keep existing carrier validation. A pure clone-only deterministic placeholder tree with distinct recursive identities can support structural roundtrip; alternatively explicitly reject and document this unsupported fresh case. Do not mint merely to make preview succeed.

Current preview/candidate checks call the same planner as actual add. Split a pure structural/capacity plan from commit-only historical floor refresh and mint. Repeated preview must leave File bytes, high-water, live resources and ground objects untouched, including malformed data and unavailable authority.

Canonical raw UserItem.slots, hydrated ItemState.socketed, captured_socket_positions and metadata.slots mirror the same physical tree. Issue once per original canonical node in parent-first order, then fully rehydrate from assigned raw tree. Updating root or hydrated children alone leaves stale captured identities or doubles issuance. Strip only IDs/count for comparison; preserve sparse slot positions and every other frozen protocol field.

Current assigned source collision normalization/exact equality runs after the full-absorption merge branch. Move collision detection before any merge so collisions with a target stack, equipment, storage, reserved or nested IDs cannot be swallowed. Assigned insertion keeps exact root/children; complete absorption may retire incoming identity while retaining destination stack IDs, and never reissues.

Only real legal Crystal grid slots may be chosen; remove preferred-slot/out-of-range fallback. Plan all merge and new stacks before mint. Authority exhaustion may burn an issued prefix but must publish no partial merge/items, no GainedItem/success notification, and must leave the ground entity. Local pickup already despawns after add success.

Fresh shadow/fenced requests reject even if fully absorbed and requiring no fresh root. Commit a Durable fresh merge-only operation only after validating the bound authority/history refresh; corrupt File must not allow asset growth without any mint call. Whole assigned custody does not require a fresh allocator and must not read/repair/rebuild it.

Simulation commit_shared_ground_drop_pickup_transaction is a live mutator. PG persists the quantity receipt/intent then projects into a character save; unassigned payload there does not freeze future minted IDs. Do not add UID issuance to unknown receipt replay/materialization or restore unresolved claims to another player. PG/shared immutable identity receipt migration remains separate and public File opt-in stays disabled.

crystalSource.observed: Dead/owner/same-cell checks; CanGainItem first, then GainItem, then remove/despawn ground object.
Whole player drop passes original UserItem; partial drop at7483 uses CreateFreshItem and preserves source remaining stack.
AddItem preserves destination stack identity, merges and routes potion/scroll/script/amulet to designated belt ranges; remainder uses available inventory.
CanGainItem checks free grid/merge capacity. No added reject-overweight rule belongs to this UID slice.
GainItem clones wire item, AddItem mutates inventory, then RefreshBagWeight.
CreateFreshItem and CreateDropItem(4413) already issue ++NextUserItemID at generation. Current Rust deferred pickup mint is a compatibility migration slice, not full timing parity.
ItemObject holds the original UserItem, including UID and frozen metadata.

proposedNewTests.name: preview_and_candidate_checks_never_touch_uid_authority
proposedNewTests.assert: Repeat direct can_gain and current-cell candidate checks, with a corrupt sidecar; exact File bytes/high-water/live inventory/ground payload remain unchanged.

proposedNewTests.name: fresh_personal_pickup_issues_once_and_keeps_frozen_wire_fields
proposedNewTests.assert: Real pickup issues global UID, packet equals frozen raw item except assigned UID/final count, then removes ground object; repeated pickup issues nothing.

proposedNewTests.name: fresh_sparse_nested_tree_rehydrates_each_node_once
proposedNewTests.assert: Sparse slots with same-template children plus nested descendant retain raw fields/positions; all physical nodes get distinct global IDs and no preview/old/temp IDs survive metadata or packet.

proposedNewTests.name: capacity_failure_after_tentative_merge_has_no_publication_or_mint
proposedNewTests.assert: Partial compatible stack then full legal grid; no tentative growth/GainedItem/ground removal/high-water advance.

proposedNewTests.name: mid_tree_uid_exhaustion_burns_prefix_without_losing_drop
proposedNewTests.assert: Two-or-more nodes at u64 exhaustion; earlier UID stays retired, entire live inventory and original ground entity unchanged.

proposedNewTests.name: fresh_merge_only_fault_and_fences_fail_closed
proposedNewTests.assert: Fresh request could fully merge; corrupt File, Unavailable and Fenced cannot increase stack or generate success.

proposedNewTests.name: assigned_custody_returns_exact_tree_without_mint_authority
proposedNewTests.assert: Whole assigned raw root/children preserved under unavailable/corrupt allocator; original File bytes untouched, no new IDs.

proposedNewTests.name: assigned_collision_is_rejected_before_whole_stack_absorption
proposedNewTests.assert: A root collision with merge target or a child collision with equipment/storage/reserved prevents both preview and add, retaining payload and quantities.

proposedNewTests.name: partial_player_drop_preserves_source_and_distinct_new_remainder
proposedNewTests.assert: Original remaining stack UID stays; dropped partial stays unassigned; merging back preserves original UID without duplicate, while a new receiver stack is minted independently.

proposedNewTests.name: legal_grid_limits_and_legacy_identity_regressions_remain
proposedNewTests.assert: No preferred_slot200 or slot beyond actual Bag/Quest grid; valid Legacy local-normalization behavior and existing exact tree/metadata assertions remain.
